why_ai: Crews and operators keep a physical grid energised under public-safety and regulatory accountability, and AI-driven load growth raises demand for the service itself.
why_clarity: Reliability indices, interconnection screens and tariff rules make most deliverables measurable and codified, though planning and storm judgement stay tacit.
why_digital: The product is electricity over local wires bought only from the franchise holder, even though meters and control systems are digital.

why_ai: Engineers sign studies that commit capital and decide who connects, under regulatory scrutiny and rising load growth.
why_clarity: Load-flow methods are codified, but each feeder differs and whether a study was right is known only after energisation.
why_digital: Network models and data in, study reports out, for applicants who must use their local utility.

why_ai: Tariff screens are rule-based and high volume, so most of the decision is automatable with engineers signing exceptions.
why_clarity: Thousands of near-identical applications are checked against written screens with quick pass or fail results.
why_digital: Applications, models and hosting maps are all digital; applicants are tied to their utility.

why_ai: Few, huge, commercially negotiated requests with capital and reliability at stake make each decision novel and accountable.
why_clarity: Every request is bespoke and whether the promised megawatts materialise is known years later.
why_digital: Studies and negotiations happen on screens and in meetings with developers who must deal with the local utility.

why_ai: Witnesses personally defend the filing under cross-examination before a commission in an adversarial process.
why_clarity: Filing requirements are codified, but each case is contested and outcomes arrive months later as negotiated orders.
why_digital: Ledgers and workbooks in, testimony and filings out, argued before a state commission.

why_ai: Restoration is physical work in damaged terrain, with high-stakes staging calls made before the storm arrives.
why_clarity: Restored customers are counted hour by hour, but each storm differs and staging is done by experience.
why_digital: Crews, poles and wire are physical; coordination is by phone and conference call among regional utilities.

why_ai: Foresters judge trees on site and utilities carry wildfire liability, with demand for mitigation rising.
why_clarity: Inspection and trimming repeat across every mile, but ignitions are rare so effectiveness is proven slowly.
why_digital: Imagery and work data feed the programme, but the work is trees cut by local crews.

why_ai: Small member- and city-owned utilities run physical grids with crews who know their communities personally.
why_clarity: Small systems follow standard practice and outages and bills are quickly checked.
why_digital: Physical local service bought only from the community's own utility.

why_ai: Eligibility and arrangements are rule-driven, but hardship cases and wrongful-disconnection liability need a person.
why_clarity: State protections and programmes are written rules applied to many similar accounts, though arrangement success shows months later.
why_digital: Billing data in and decisions out, delivered through calls, letters and sometimes a field disconnection.

why_ai: Exception handling on interval data is pattern work that models can take over.
why_clarity: Validation rules are codified and repeated across millions of meters with quick field confirmation.
why_digital: Meter data in and corrected reads out on screens, with occasional truck rolls; internal to the utility.

why_ai: Designers visit sites and stamp layouts that must meet safety standards, but standard jobs repeat.
why_clarity: Standards and compatible units define designs, and field construction quickly shows whether they work.
why_digital: Site plans and design tools are digital, but staking and the result are physical and local.

why_ai: Forecasts are defended by witnesses in contested resource-plan proceedings as data-centre load reshapes demand.
why_clarity: Forecasts are checkable against published actual load each year, though methods vary by consultant.
why_digital: Data and models in, reports and testimony out, sold to utilities nationally.

why_ai: Regulatory staff and witnesses carry the utility's revenue case before commissions under cross-examination.
why_clarity: Filings follow codified requirements but recur only every few years per state and are settled slowly.
why_digital: Workbooks and filings on screens, argued before state commissions.

why_ai: Expert witnesses are retained for their credibility and personally defend adjustments under cross-examination.
why_clarity: Each case is contested and outcomes arrive as negotiated orders months later.
why_digital: Filings and discovery in, testimony out, delivered remotely and at hearings across states.

why_ai: Award brands carry some trust, but survey analysis is readily automated.
why_clarity: A fixed annual study design repeated each year with clear scores.
why_digital: Survey data in, studies and licences delivered online.

why_ai: Summarising public dockets is automatable, though the rankings depend on analyst judgement and reputation.
why_clarity: Case outcomes are structured facts recorded the same way for every case.
why_digital: Public dockets in, subscription data and reports out online.

why_ai: Models feed regulator-reviewed plans and shutoff decisions where errors carry high stakes.
why_clarity: Ignitions are rare, so model skill is hard to prove and methods differ by vendor.
why_digital: Fuel, weather and asset data in, risk maps and forecasts out, sold to utilities remotely.

why_ai: Forecasting from weather and asset data is model work, with some meteorologist judgement on big events.
why_clarity: Each forecast is checked within days by the outages that follow.
why_digital: Weather and outage data in, forecasts and briefings out, delivered remotely.

why_ai: Compiling public filings into datasets is directly automatable.
why_clarity: Data products are defined fields refreshed on fixed release schedules and checked against sources.
why_digital: Public data in, subscription data out, fully online.

why_ai: Research programmes combine lab and field testing with member relationships built over decades.
why_clarity: Research projects are bespoke and their value is judged slowly.
why_digital: Mostly data and reports with some lab and field work, delivered to members worldwide.

why_ai: Generation and transmission are physical operations run for member utilities with close governance ties.
why_clarity: Supply, planning and rate work follow standard practice with measurable reliability and cost.
why_digital: Power plants and lines are physical; members buy through long-term wholesale contracts.

why_ai: Underwriting wildfire and liability risk for members is high-stakes judgement built on long relationships.
why_clarity: Pricing follows actuarial methods, but large losses that test it are rare.
why_digital: Submissions in, policies and pricing out, placed remotely with member utilities.

why_ai: Statutory reliability authority under FERC oversight cannot be handed to software.
why_clarity: Standards are codified, but assessments of future reliability are judged only as events unfold.
why_digital: Filings and evidence in, assessments and findings out, within a regulated registry.

why_ai: Software vendors face AI-native competitors, though engineering credibility and integration slow substitution.
why_clarity: Power-flow methods are codified and results checkable against studies.
why_digital: Models and data in, software and analytics out, sold to utilities remotely.

why_ai: Lending to cooperatives rests on long relationships and accountable credit decisions.
why_clarity: Credit analysis follows ratio methods, but defaults that test it are rare.
why_digital: Financial reports in, loans and benchmarks out, through relationship lending.

why_ai: Statutory survey authority keeps the function public, but no licensed person signs the output and processing is automatable.
why_clarity: Defined survey forms repeated annually with validation rules.
why_digital: Electronic survey responses in, public datasets out online.

why_ai: Membership trust carries the surveys, but compiling statistics is automatable.
why_clarity: Annual surveys repeat the same questions to the same members.
why_digital: Survey data in, reports out to members online.

why_ai: Refurbishing and moving heavy equipment is physical, and shortages keep demand strong.
why_clarity: A unit either tests and performs or it doesn't, though sourcing varies job to job.
why_digital: Physical equipment sold nationally by phone and online listings.
